Title: Learn, connect, and share feedback with Microsoft experts

Body.Content:
Microsoft Q&A is the new place to get expert answers from Microsoft engineers and community experts, validated by customer experiences. Find topics categorized by users, products, recent and popular posts, and connect with engineers through direct messaging within the Microsoft Q&A community. This single community will help deepen your Azure knowledge so you can deploy Azure services with confidence. Both MSDN and TechNet online forums will be replaced by Microsoft Q&A to provide one place for you to get expert answers to your technical questions.

Visit Microsoft Q&A
